rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Well done making it back, everyone. I must brief you on the situation right away.

<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)><book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()>'s <book(13)>5th Luna<endbook()> Drop Operation has failed. The <book(29)>Martian Successors<endbook()>, and the former <book(18)>Giganos<endbook()>'s breakup...
rows.notes: Restructured so book(12) precedes book(13), matching source tag order. Martian Successors = book(29) per glossary.json org.martian_successors / 4003160,4003220 precedent.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>So <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()>, now at a disadvantage, had been seeking peace talks with the <book(9)>Earth Federation<endbook()> government<thumbnail(287)>.
rows.notes: Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>But... All of that was nothing more than <color(5)>Char<ce()>'s scheme.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Handed over by the <book(9)>Earth Federation<endbook()> in exchange for disarmament, <book(14)>Axis<endbook()> - dropped onto Earth.
rows.notes: Kept as a sentence fragment, as in the source (object clause continuing into slot 24); restructured so book(9) precedes book(14), matching source tag order.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)><book(14)>Axis<endbook()> has already begun accelerating, and is now on a fall path toward Earth. Intel also says nuclear weapons are aboard.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>If this <book(14)>Axis<endbook()> Drop becomes reality, the damage to Earth will be immeasurable.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>A nuclear winter<thumbnail(239)> will come, and Earth will become a land unfit for human habitation.
rows.notes: Same thumbnail id (239) as the 'nuclear winter' caption reused verbatim from reviewed scene 4003200.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>From here on, we will exert every ounce of strength we have, and carry out the operation to stop <book(14)>Axis<endbook()>'s fall.
<thumbdown()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Naturally, enemy resistance will be fierce. This is truly the critical moment. But... we have no choice but to do it.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I want you to go into this ready to give everything you have.
